description: Duplicate a project's STRUCTURE (POST /projects/:id/clone): its task lists (not a work order's own lists), their tasks (never coordination cards) with response types, photo, safety and signature settings, subtasks, and attachments by reference, plus the location, dates, labor rules and report options. Nothing that happened is copied: no completions, issues, receipts, assignments or access settings. The copy gets the next project number and the name "<name> (copy)" unless you pass one. All or nothing: the copy is one database transaction, so a failure leaves nothing behind. Write tier.
name: tascan_clone_project
